title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems supporting high-volume applications. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product managers, QA engineers, and architects to deliver reliable services and APIs.

Responsibilities:
- Design and develop scalable backend services and RESTful APIs.
- Write clean, maintainable, well-tested production code.
- Optimize application performance, database queries, and system reliability.
- Participate in architecture and technical design discussions.
- Review code and mentor junior engineers.
- Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
- Build automated tests and improve engineering quality standards.
- Collaborate with product teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
- Contribute to CI/CD, observability, and deployment improvements.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 5–8 years of professional software development experience.
- Strong experience with Java, Python, Go, Node.js, or a similar backend language.
- Strong understanding of databases, APIs, caching, and distributed systems.
- Experience with Git, testing, and modern development practices.
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience designing high-traffic or distributed systems.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We are seeking a Data Scientist to develop analytical and machine learning solutions that help the business make better decisions. The role involves working with large datasets, building predictive models, conducting experiments, and communicating insights to business and technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
- Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends and opportunities.
- Build and validate statistical and machine learning models.
- Develop predictive models for customer, product, and business use cases.
- Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering.
- Design and analyze experiments and A/B tests.
- Present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
- Collaborate with engineers to productionize successful models.
- Monitor model performance and recommend improvements.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.
- 3–6 years of experience in data science or a similar analytical role.
- Strong Python and SQL skills.
- Experience with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or similar tools.
- Strong understanding of statistics, probability, and machine learning.
- Ability to communicate technical findings clearly.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Knowledge of cloud platforms and MLOps.
- Experience with recommendation systems, NLP, or customer analytics.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
We are looking for a UX/UI Designer to create intuitive, accessible, and visually engaging digital experiences. You will collaborate with product managers, researchers, engineers, and other designers throughout the product development lifecycle.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct user research and translate findings into design opportunities.
- Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
- Design responsive experiences for web and mobile platforms.
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure design feasibility.
- Maintain and contribute to the company's design system.
- Conduct usability testing and incorporate user feedback.
- Present design decisions and concepts to stakeholders.
- Identify opportunities to simplify complex user journeys.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.
- 2–5 years of professional UX/UI design experience.
- Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work.
- Proficiency in Figma or equivalent design tools.
- Strong understanding of typography, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and usability.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience designing fintech, SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer applications.
- Familiarity with design systems and accessibility standards.
- Basic understanding of HTML and CSS is an advantage.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We are hiring a Digital Marketing Specialist to plan and execute campaigns across paid, organic, social, and content channels. The role requires a data-driven marketer who can manage campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve customer acquisition.

Responsibilities:
- Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other platforms.
- Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets based on ROI.
- Develop landing pages, email campaigns, and promotional content in collaboration with creative teams.
- Track KPIs such as CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and lead quality.
- Conduct A/B testing across advertisements and landing pages.
- Coordinate with SEO and content teams to improve organic acquisition.
- Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
- Research competitors and identify new marketing opportunities.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
- 2–4 years of digital marketing experience.
- Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- Strong understanding of digital analytics and conversion funnels.
- Good Excel or spreadsheet skills.
- Strong communication and analytical abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, HubSpot, or similar tools.
- Experience in e-commerce, SaaS, fintech, or D2C businesses.
- Knowledge of SEO and marketing automation.

title: Financial Accountant
description:
We are looking for a Financial Accountant to manage accounting activities, reconciliations, reporting, and financial controls. The successful candidate will ensure accurate financial records and support month-end and year-end closing processes.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate general ledger records and accounting entries.
- Perform bank, vendor, customer, and balance-sheet reconciliations.
- Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing.
- Prepare financial statements and management reports.
- Review invoices, expenses, and supporting documentation.
- Assist with statutory audits and tax-related requirements.
- Monitor accounts payable and receivable activities.
- Identify discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions.
- Maintain proper documentation for financial transactions.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of accounting experience.
- Strong understanding of Indian accounting principles and GST basics.
- Good knowledge of Tally, SAP, Oracle, or similar accounting software.
- Strong Excel skills.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to meet deadlines during financial closing periods.

Preferred Qualifications:
- CA Inter, CMA, or equivalent qualification.
- Experience working in a corporate finance environment.
- Knowledge of financial reporting and audit processes.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage recruitment activities across multiple business functions. You will partner with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements, source candidates, manage interviews, and deliver a strong candidate experience.

Responsibilities:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned positions.
- Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and hiring priorities.
- Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, and professional networks.
- Screen candidates and conduct initial interviews.
- Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
- Manage candidate communication and offer processes.
- Maintain accurate recruitment records and hiring dashboards.
- Build talent pipelines for recurring and critical positions.
- Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of experience in talent acquisition or recruitment.
- Strong knowledge of sourcing and interviewing techniques.
- Experience using ATS platforms and recruitment portals.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience hiring technology, sales, or corporate professionals.
- Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter.
- Experience in a fast-growing organization.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
We are seeking a Business Development Manager to identify new revenue opportunities, build strategic relationships, and grow the company's customer base. The role requires strong communication, negotiation, prospecting, and commercial skills.

Responsibilities:
- Identify and qualify new business opportunities within assigned markets.
- Build and maintain relationships with prospective and existing customers.
- Conduct sales presentations, product demonstrations, and commercial discussions.
- Develop proposals and negotiate contracts in collaboration with internal teams.
- Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast.
- Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.
- Research competitors and market trends.
- Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer success teams.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activity reports.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
- 4–7 years of business development or B2B sales experience.
- Proven record of achieving revenue targets.
- Strong negotiation and presentation skills.
- Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
- Strong commercial awareness and relationship-building abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience selling SaaS, technology, financial services, or enterprise solutions.
- Existing network of corporate decision-makers is an advantage.
- MBA is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Registered Staff Nurse
description:
We are seeking a compassionate and qualified Staff Nurse to provide high-quality patient care in a hospital environment. The role requires strong clinical knowledge, attention to patient safety, and the ability to work effectively with doctors and multidisciplinary healthcare teams.

Responsibilities:
- Provide direct nursing care to patients according to prescribed treatment plans.
- Monitor patient vital signs and report changes to physicians.
- Administer medications and treatments safely and accurately.
- Maintain complete and timely patient documentation.
- Assist doctors during examinations and procedures.
- Educate patients and families regarding treatment, medication, and aftercare.
- Follow infection-control and hospital safety protocols.
- Respond appropriately to emergencies and clinical changes.
- Coordinate with laboratory, pharmacy, and other hospital departments.

Requirements:
- B.Sc Nursing or GNM qualification from a recognized institution.
- Valid registration with the applicable State Nursing Council.
- 1–4 years of clinical nursing experience preferred.
- Strong knowledge of patient-care procedures and medication safety.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in ICU, emergency, surgical, medical, or critical-care units.
- BLS/ACLS certification is an advantage.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
We are hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer to develop mechanical components, assemblies, and engineering solutions for industrial products. You will work with manufacturing, quality, procurement, and engineering teams from concept development through production.

Responsibilities:
- Create detailed 2D drawings and 3D CAD models for mechanical components and assemblies.
- Develop designs based on functional, manufacturing, and cost requirements.
- Perform design calculations and tolerance analysis.
- Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure designs are production-ready.
- Participate in design reviews and engineering change processes.
- Investigate product failures and recommend design improvements.
- Maintain engineering drawings, BOMs, and technical documentation.
- Support prototype development and testing.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
- 2–5 years of mechanical design experience.
- Proficiency with SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, AutoCAD, or similar CAD tools.
- Understanding of GD&T, manufacturing processes, and engineering materials.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in automotive, industrial machinery, consumer products, or manufacturing.
- Knowledge of FMEA and design-for-manufacturing principles.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Cybersecurity Analyst to help protect the organization's systems, applications, networks, and data from security threats. You will monitor security events, investigate incidents, support vulnerability management, and contribute to improving the organization's security posture.

Responsibilities:
- Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious activity.
- Analyze logs from endpoints, servers, firewalls, and security tools.
- Assist with incident response and security investigations.
- Identify vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation with technology teams.
- Support endpoint, network, and application security initiatives.
- Maintain security documentation and incident reports.
- Participate in security audits and compliance activities.
- Research emerging threats and recommend appropriate controls.
- Help improve security monitoring and detection rules.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of experience in cybersecurity or security operations.
- Understanding of networking, operating systems, authentication, and common attack techniques.
- Experience with SIEM or security monitoring platforms.
- Strong analytical and incident-investigation skills.
- Good understanding of security best practices.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Security certifications such as Security+, CEH, or equivalent.
- Experience with Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, or similar platforms.
- Familiarity with cloud security and vulnerability-management tools.

title: Product Manager
description:
We are looking for a Product Manager to own product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and execution for a key product area. You will work with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and business teams to deliver products that solve customer problems and generate measurable business value.

Responsibilities:
- Define product vision, goals, and roadmap.
- Conduct customer and market research to identify product opportunities.
- Convert business and customer requirements into clear product specifications.
- Prioritize features based on customer value, business impact, and engineering effort.
- Work closely with engineering and design teams during product development.
- Define product metrics and evaluate product performance after launch.
- Lead product launches and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders.
- Analyze user feedback, market trends, and product data.
- Continuously improve the product based on measurable outcomes.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
- 4–7 years of product management or related experience.
- Strong understanding of product development and agile methodologies.
- Experience writing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to make decisions using qualitative and quantitative data.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA or equivalent qualification.
- Experience with fintech, SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer technology.
- Experience launching products from concept through production.

title: Operations Executive
description:
We are hiring an Operations Executive to support day-to-day business operations and ensure processes are completed accurately and efficiently. The ideal candidate will be organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with multiple teams and operational systems.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate daily operational activities and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
- Maintain operational records, reports, and documentation.
- Monitor process performance and identify recurring operational issues.
- Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and service partners.
- Resolve routine operational exceptions and escalate complex issues.
- Track key performance indicators and prepare regular reports.
- Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures.
- Suggest improvements to reduce errors, delays, and operational costs.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Commerce, or a related field.
- 0–2 years of experience; fresh graduates may apply.
- Good knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.
- Strong organizational and communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
- Attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Previous internship or experience in operations, logistics, retail, or e-commerce.
- Familiarity with CRM, ERP, or workflow-management systems.

title: Content Writer
description:
We are looking for a Content Writer to create clear, engaging, and search-optimized content for our website, campaigns, product pages, and digital channels. You will work with marketing, SEO, product, and design teams to produce content aligned with business and audience goals.

Responsibilities:
- Write and edit website pages, blogs, product content, newsletters, and marketing copy.
- Research topics and create accurate, useful, audience-focused content.
- Optimize content for search engines while maintaining natural readability.
- Work with SEO specialists to identify keywords and content opportunities.
- Adapt tone and messaging for different audiences and platforms.
- Proofread content for grammar, consistency, and factual accuracy.
- Maintain content calendars and meet publishing deadlines.
- Repurpose existing content for social media and other channels.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
- 2–4 years of professional content-writing experience.
- Excellent written English and strong editing skills.
- Understanding of SEO and content marketing principles.
- Strong research and storytelling abilities.
- Ability to simplify complex subjects for general audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with SaaS, technology, finance, or B2B content.
- Familiarity with WordPress, Google Analytics, and SEO tools.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Analyst to analyze inventory, procurement, logistics, and fulfillment data and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency. The role combines analytical skills with practical supply chain knowledge.

Responsibilities:
- Analyze inventory levels, demand forecasts, purchase orders, and fulfillment performance.
- Prepare dashboards and reports for supply chain leadership.
- Identify slow-moving, excess, or insufficient inventory.
- Analyze supplier performance and delivery trends.
- Support demand planning and inventory optimization initiatives.
- Track logistics costs and identify cost-reduction opportunities.
- Work with procurement, warehouse, sales, and finance teams.
- Improve reporting processes through automation and standardization.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of supply chain or business analytics experience.
- Strong Excel and data-analysis skills.
- Understanding of inventory management and supply chain processes.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with SAP, Oracle, Power BI, or similar systems.
- Knowledge of SQL or Python is an advantage.
- MBA in Operations or Supply Chain Management is preferred.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to build long-term relationships with customers and ensure they achieve measurable value from our products. You will own customer onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion for a portfolio of accounts.

Responsibilities:
- Manage relationships with assigned customers throughout the customer lifecycle.
- Lead onboarding and product adoption programs.
- Understand customer goals and develop success plans.
- Conduct regular business reviews with key accounts.
- Monitor product usage, customer health, renewals, and satisfaction.
- Identify opportunities for account expansion and cross-selling.
- Coordinate with support, product, sales, and engineering teams to resolve customer issues.
- Collect customer feedback and communicate product improvement opportunities.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
- 3–6 years of customer success, account management, or B2B relationship-management experience.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Strong customer-facing and problem-solving abilities.
- Experience working with CRM and customer-success platforms.
- Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in SaaS or technology businesses.
- Experience managing enterprise customers.
- Understanding of retention, churn, expansion, and customer-lifetime-value metrics.

title: Civil Site Engineer
description:
We are hiring a Civil Site Engineer to supervise construction activities and ensure projects are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and schedules. The role requires regular coordination with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management teams.

Responsibilities:
- Supervise day-to-day construction activities at the project site.
- Review drawings, specifications, and method statements.
- Monitor work quality and ensure compliance with engineering standards.
- Coordinate with contractors and subcontractors.
- Track project progress against planned schedules.
- Inspect materials and workmanship and report quality issues.
- Maintain site records, measurements, and daily progress reports.
- Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and project managers.
- Assist with quantity estimation and material planning.
- Ensure compliance with site safety procedures.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering.
- 2–5 years of experience in construction or infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of construction methods, drawings, quantity estimation, and site supervision.
- Ability to read engineering drawings.
- Strong coordination and communication skills.
- Willingness to work from construction sites and travel when required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with commercial, residential, industrial, or infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Project is an advantage.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative Graphic Designer to develop visual assets for digital campaigns, social media, websites, presentations, and brand communications. The successful candidate will combine strong visual design skills with an understanding of marketing objectives.

Responsibilities:
- Create graphics for social media, websites, advertisements, email campaigns, and presentations.
- Develop visual concepts based on campaign and brand requirements.
- Maintain consistency with brand guidelines.
- Collaborate with marketing, content, product, and creative teams.
- Adapt designs across multiple formats and platforms.
- Manage multiple creative projects while meeting deadlines.
- Review and improve existing marketing materials.
- Stay current with design trends and digital content formats.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of professional design experience.
- Strong portfolio demonstrating digital and marketing design work.
- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma, or equivalent tools.
- Strong understanding of typography, color, composition, and layout.
- Excellent attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in digital marketing, advertising, e-commerce, or consumer brands.
- Motion graphics or basic video-editing skills are a plus.

title: Risk & Compliance Manager
description:
We are seeking a Risk & Compliance Manager to identify, assess, and manage operational and regulatory risks across the organization. You will work with business and technology teams to strengthen controls, monitor compliance, and support audits and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities:
- Identify and assess operational, regulatory, and process-related risks.
- Develop and maintain risk registers and control frameworks.
- Conduct periodic control assessments and compliance reviews.
- Monitor regulatory changes and assess their business impact.
- Coordinate internal and external audits.
- Track remediation plans and ensure issues are resolved within agreed timelines.
- Prepare risk reports and dashboards for senior management.
- Work with business teams to implement effective controls.
- Support risk awareness and compliance training initiatives.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline.
- 5–8 years of experience in risk, compliance, audit, or financial services.
- Strong understanding of operational risk and internal controls.
- Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
- Ability to interpret regulations and translate requirements into practical controls.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA, CA, CISA, CIA, FRM, or equivalent qualification.
- Experience in banking, fintech, NBFC, insurance, or regulated financial services.
- Familiarity with RBI regulations is an advantage.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure and scalable cloud infrastructure. You will collaborate with software engineering and DevOps teams to improve application reliability, deployment automation, monitoring, and cloud efficiency.

Responsibilities:
- Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across development and production environments.
- Implement infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
- Configure networking, compute, storage, databases, and security services.
- Automate deployment and operational processes.
- Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, and costs.
- Troubleshoot cloud and production infrastructure issues.
- Implement backup, disaster recovery, and security controls.
- Collaborate with development teams on cloud architecture decisions.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.
- 3–6 years of cloud or infrastructure engineering experience.
- Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Good knowledge of Linux, networking, containers, and cloud security.
- Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- AWS/Azure/GCP professional certification.
- Experience with Kubernetes and Docker.
- Knowledge of Python, Bash, or another scripting language.

title: Medical Laboratory Technologist
description:
We are seeking a Medical Laboratory Technologist to perform diagnostic laboratory tests accurately and safely while maintaining high standards of quality and patient care. The successful candidate will work with clinical teams and laboratory staff to process samples and report results efficiently.

Responsibilities:
- Collect, receive, label, and process patient specimens according to laboratory procedures.
- Perform routine and specialized laboratory tests.
- Operate and maintain laboratory equipment.
- Follow quality-control procedures and investigate abnormal results.
- Maintain accurate laboratory records and documentation.
- Follow infection-control, safety, and biomedical-waste procedures.
- Coordinate with doctors and nursing teams when clarification is required.
- Ensure timely processing and reporting of test results.

Requirements:
- B.Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent qualification.
- 1–4 years of relevant laboratory experience preferred.
- Knowledge of hematology, biochemistry, microbiology, or pathology procedures.
- Strong attention to detail and adherence to laboratory protocols.
- Ability to work shifts where required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience working in a hospital or diagnostic laboratory.
- Familiarity with laboratory information systems and automated analyzers.

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
We are looking for an Inside Sales Executive to generate qualified leads, engage prospective customers, and convert opportunities into revenue. The role involves outbound and inbound sales activities, product demonstrations, follow-ups, and CRM management.

Responsibilities:
- Contact prospective customers through phone, email, and online channels.
- Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
- Conduct product demonstrations and sales presentations.
- Qualify leads and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
- Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales cycle.
- Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
- Maintain accurate activity and opportunity records in the CRM.
- Collaborate with marketing and account-management teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
- 1–3 years of inside sales or business development experience.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Comfortable making outbound calls and handling objections.
- Goal-oriented mindset with strong follow-up discipline.
- Familiarity with CRM systems is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience selling SaaS, education, fintech, or technology products.
- Previous experience working with B2B customers is an advantage.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
We are looking for a Procurement Manager to manage sourcing, supplier relationships, negotiations, purchasing processes, and cost optimization. The role will work closely with finance, operations, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure timely and cost-effective procurement.

Responsibilities:
- Develop sourcing strategies for assigned categories.
- Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers.
- Manage purchase orders, contracts, and supplier agreements.
- Monitor supplier performance, quality, delivery, and pricing.
- Negotiate commercial terms and identify cost-saving opportunities.
- Work with internal stakeholders to forecast procurement requirements.
- Maintain supplier documentation and procurement records.
- Resolve supplier disputes and delivery issues.
- Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
- 5–8 years of procurement or strategic sourcing experience.
- Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
- Good understanding of procurement processes and commercial contracts.
- Strong analytical and cost-analysis abilities.
- Experience using ERP or procurement-management systems.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA in Supply Chain or Operations.
- Experience in manufacturing, automotive, infrastructure, or large-scale operations.
- Knowledge of strategic sourcing and category management.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
We are looking for a Frontend Developer to build responsive, accessible, and high-performance web applications. You will work closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, and QA teams to deliver polished digital experiences.

Responsibilities:
- Develop reusable and maintainable frontend components.
- Build responsive interfaces for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
- Integrate frontend applications with REST and GraphQL APIs.
- Optimize applications for performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
- Write unit and integration tests for frontend functionality.
- Troubleshoot UI issues and production bugs.
- Collaborate with designers to accurately implement visual specifications.
- Contribute to frontend architecture and coding standards.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of professional frontend development experience.
- Strong knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
- Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
- Good understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and browser fundamentals.
- Experience working with Git and modern development workflows.
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Next.js or similar frameworks.
- Familiarity with automated testing tools such as Jest or Cypress.
- Understanding of web accessibility and performance optimization.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to develop, deploy, and maintain machine learning systems that solve real-world business problems. You will work with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to take models from experimentation to production.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and deploy machine learning models for production use cases.
- Prepare datasets and implement feature engineering pipelines.
- Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical and business metrics.
- Build scalable inference and model-serving systems.
- Collaborate with data scientists to productionize research models.
- Monitor model performance, data quality, and model drift.
- Improve existing ML pipelines for reliability and scalability.
- Document models, experiments, and technical decisions.
- Participate in code reviews and engineering design discussions.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
- 3–6 years of experience in machine learning or software engineering.
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Experience with scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
- Good understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
- Experience with data processing and SQL.
- Understanding of software engineering principles and APIs.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with MLOps, MLflow, Kubernetes, or cloud ML platforms.
- Knowledge of NLP, recommendation systems, computer vision, or generative AI.
- Experience deploying models at scale.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
We are looking for an HR Business Partner to work closely with business leaders and employees on workforce planning, employee engagement, performance management, organizational development, and people-related initiatives.

Responsibilities:
- Partner with business leaders to understand workforce and organizational needs.
- Provide guidance on employee relations and people-management matters.
- Support performance management and talent-development processes.
- Analyze employee engagement and retention metrics.
- Develop and implement HR initiatives aligned with business goals.
- Support workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational development.
- Partner with talent acquisition and learning teams on hiring and development needs.
- Ensure HR policies and practices are applied consistently.
- Handle sensitive employee matters with professionalism and confidentiality.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 5–8 years of HR experience, including HRBP or generalist responsibilities.
- Strong understanding of employee relations and performance management.
- Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA in Human Resources.
- Experience working with technology, consulting, or large corporate organizations.
- Experience with HR analytics and HRIS platforms.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are hiring a DevOps Engineer to automate infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and operational processes across our technology environment. You will work closely with developers and cloud engineers to improve deployment speed, reliability, scalability, and security.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application deployments.
- Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
- Manage cloud infrastructure and production environments.
- Monitor system performance, availability, and resource utilization.
- Troubleshoot deployment and infrastructure issues.
- Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions.
- Manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
- Improve infrastructure security and access controls.
- Participate in incident response and post-incident reviews.

We are hiring a Technical Support Engineer to help customers troubleshoot technical issues involving our software products. You will investigate problems, communicate solutions, document incidents, and collaborate with engineering teams on complex technical cases.

Responsibilities:
- Provide technical support through email, chat, and support tickets.
- Investigate application, configuration, and integration issues.
- Reproduce customer-reported problems and identify root causes.
- Review logs, API responses, and system behavior to diagnose issues.
- Escalate complex defects to engineering teams with detailed information.
- Maintain accurate support documentation and knowledge-base articles.
- Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers.
- Monitor recurring issues and recommend product improvements.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- 0–2 years of technical-support experience; fresh graduates are welcome.
- Basic understanding of APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
- Good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication.
- Willingness to work rotational shifts if required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Knowledge of SQL and REST APIs.
- Familiarity with tools such as Postman, Jira, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
- Previous internship in software support or engineering.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support electrical design, testing, maintenance, and project execution activities. The role involves working with engineering and operations teams to ensure electrical systems meet technical, safety, and quality requirements.

Responsibilities:
- Assist with electrical system design and engineering documentation.
- Review electrical drawings, specifications, and technical documents.
- Support installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
- Troubleshoot electrical equipment and system issues.
- Coordinate with contractors and vendors on engineering activities.
- Maintain technical records and project documentation.
- Support preventive-maintenance activities.
- Ensure work complies with electrical safety standards.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
- 0–3 years of relevant experience; fresh graduates are welcome.
- Understanding of electrical circuits, equipment, and safety principles.
- Basic knowledge of electrical drawings and engineering standards.
- Familiarity with AutoCAD or electrical-design tools is preferred.
- Good analytical, communication, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship or academic project experience in electrical engineering.
- Knowledge of PLCs, industrial automation, or power systems is an advantage.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
We are looking for an SEO Specialist to improve organic search visibility, traffic, and conversions across our digital properties. You will work with content, development, and marketing teams to identify SEO opportunities and execute optimization strategies.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct keyword research and develop SEO recommendations.
- Optimize website pages, metadata, headings, and internal linking.
- Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and search performance.
- Conduct technical SEO audits and identify website issues.
- Collaborate with content writers to develop search-friendly content.
- Analyze competitors and identify content opportunities.
- Track SEO performance using analytics and search-console tools.
- Support link-building and digital PR initiatives.
- Prepare regular SEO performance reports.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
- 1–3 years of SEO experience.
- Good understanding of on-page, technical, and off-page SEO.
- Familiarity with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
- Experience with keyword-research and SEO tools.
- Strong analytical and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.
- Basic knowledge of HTML and website content-management systems.

title: Business Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams. You will gather requirements, analyze processes, document business needs, and support the delivery of technology and process-improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities:
- Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders.
- Analyze existing business processes and identify improvement opportunities.
- Create user stories, process flows, and functional requirements.
- Work with product and engineering teams throughout implementation.
- Facilitate stakeholder discussions and requirement workshops.
- Support user-acceptance testing and issue resolution.
- Prepare reports and presentations for business stakeholders.
- Track project requirements and maintain documentation.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
- 1–4 years of business-analysis experience.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Good understanding of requirements gathering and process mapping.
- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
- Familiarity with Excel, SQL, Jira, or similar tools.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA or relevant business-analysis certification.
- Experience working in Agile product-development environments.
- Knowledge of data visualization or business-intelligence tools.

title: Junior Accountant
description:
We are looking for a Junior Accountant to support the finance team with bookkeeping, reconciliations, invoice processing, and financial documentation. This is a suitable opportunity for commerce graduates beginning their accounting careers.

Responsibilities:
- Record daily financial transactions accurately.
- Process invoices and maintain accounts payable records.
- Assist with bank and ledger reconciliations.
- Maintain supporting documents for financial transactions.
- Assist with monthly financial closing activities.
- Prepare basic Excel reports and accounting schedules.
- Support GST and TDS documentation.
- Coordinate with internal teams regarding invoices and expenses.
- Assist senior accountants with audits and reporting.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance.
- 0–2 years of experience; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
- Basic understanding of accounting principles.
- Knowledge of MS Excel and accounting software.
- Strong numerical and organizational skills.
- Good attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with Tally Prime.
- Internship experience in accounting or finance.
- Knowledge of GST and Indian bookkeeping practices.

title: Project Manager - IT
description:
We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to lead technology projects from initiation through delivery. The role requires strong planning, stakeholder management, risk management, and communication skills to ensure projects are delivered on time and within agreed scope.

Responsibilities:
- Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and delivery plans.
- Coordinate engineering, product, design, QA, and business teams.
- Track project progress, dependencies, risks, and issues.
- Facilitate project meetings and communicate status to stakeholders.
- Manage scope changes and delivery priorities.
- Ensure project documentation is maintained accurately.
- Identify delivery risks and develop mitigation plans.
- Coordinate releases and production-readiness activities.
- Conduct post-project reviews and identify process improvements.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
- 6–10 years of IT project-management experience.
- Strong knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
- Experience managing cross-functional technology projects.
- Excellent stakeholder communication and leadership skills.
- Strong understanding of project planning, risk management, and delivery processes.

Preferred Qualifications:
- PMP, PRINCE2, or Scrum certification.
- Experience managing software-development projects.
- Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar project-management tools.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
We are looking for a Social Media Executive to help manage and grow our presence across social platforms. You will assist with content planning, publishing, community engagement, campaign execution, and performance reporting.

Responsibilities:
- Plan and schedule social media content.
- Assist in developing creative concepts for campaigns.
- Write captions and coordinate with designers and content creators.
- Monitor comments, messages, and audience interactions.
- Track engagement, reach, follower growth, and campaign performance.
- Research social media trends and competitor activity.
- Assist with paid social campaigns when required.
- Prepare weekly and monthly social-media reports.
- Maintain content calendars and ensure timely publishing.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, or a related field.
- 0–2 years of experience; fresh graduates are welcome.
- Strong understanding of major social media platforms.
- Good writing and communication skills.
- Creative mindset and strong attention to detail.
- Basic knowledge of social-media analytics.
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship experience in social media or digital marketing.
- Familiarity with Canva, Meta Business Suite, and social-media scheduling tools.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to build scalable web applications across frontend and backend layers. You will participate in feature development, API integration, database design, testing, and deployment while working with a cross-functional engineering team.

Responsibilities:
- Develop frontend interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks.
- Build backend services and REST APIs.
- Design and work with relational or NoSQL databases.
- Integrate third-party APIs and services.
- Write unit and integration tests.
- Troubleshoot application and production issues.
- Participate in architecture and code-review discussions.
- Collaborate with product, design, QA, and DevOps teams.
- Contribute to application performance and security improvements.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of full-stack development experience.
- Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and a frontend framework such as React.
- Experience with Node.js, Java, Python, or another backend technology.
- Good understanding of SQL and databases.
- Experience with Git and REST APIs.
- Strong software-development and debugging skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
- Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD.
- Knowledge of system design and scalable application architecture.

title: Graduate Software Trainee
description:
We are looking for Graduate Software Trainees to join our technology team and receive structured training in software development. This role is designed for fresh graduates who want to start their careers in application development and gain practical experience working on real products.

Responsibilities:
- Participate in technical training and onboarding programs.
- Learn the company's development frameworks, tools, and engineering practices.
- Assist senior developers in implementing application features.
- Write basic application code and unit tests.
- Debug issues and participate in troubleshooting activities.
- Work with databases and APIs under guidance.
- Participate in code reviews and team meetings.
- Document technical work and learning outcomes.
- Collaborate with QA and other engineering teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
- 0–1 year of experience; fresh graduates are strongly encouraged to apply.
- Good understanding of programming fundamentals.
- Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript.
- Basic understanding of databases and software-development concepts.
- Strong logical reasoning and willingness to learn.
- Good communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship experience in software development.
- Academic projects demonstrating programming ability.
- Familiarity with Git or basic web-development concepts.

title: Clinical Research Associate
description:
We are seeking a Clinical Research Associate to support the planning, monitoring, documentation, and execution of clinical research activities. The role involves coordination with investigators, clinical sites, study teams, and other stakeholders while ensuring adherence to applicable protocols and standards.

Responsibilities:
- Support monitoring activities for assigned clinical studies.
- Coordinate with clinical investigators and research sites.
- Review study documentation for completeness and accuracy.
- Track study milestones, queries, and action items.
- Support site initiation, monitoring, and close-out activities.
- Maintain trial documentation and reports.
- Escalate protocol deviations and operational issues appropriately.
- Collaborate with clinical operations, data-management, and safety teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Nursing, or a related field.
- 1–4 years of clinical-research experience.
- Understanding of clinical-trial processes and Good Clinical Practice principles.
- Strong documentation and organizational skills.
- Ability to communicate effectively with clinical sites and internal teams.
- Willingness to travel when required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- GCP certification or relevant clinical-research training.
- Experience working with clinical-trial documentation and electronic trial systems.

title: UI Developer Intern
description:
We are looking for a UI Developer Intern to assist the frontend team in building responsive and user-friendly web interfaces. This internship is intended for students or recent graduates who want practical experience with modern web development.

Responsibilities:
- Convert design mockups into responsive web pages.
- Assist developers in building reusable UI components.
- Write and modify HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code.
- Test interfaces across browsers and screen sizes.
- Fix basic UI issues and improve page responsiveness.
- Collaborate with designers and frontend developers.
- Learn and follow frontend coding standards and Git workflows.
- Participate in code reviews and team discussions.

Requirements:
- Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
- 0–1 year of experience.
- Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Understanding of responsive web design.
- Familiarity with Git is preferred.
- Strong willingness to learn and experiment.
- Academic or personal web-development projects are a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Basic knowledge of React or another frontend framework.
- Familiarity with Figma and browser developer tools.

title: Backend Developer
description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer to build reliable, scalable, and secure server-side applications. You will work with frontend engineers, product managers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to develop APIs and backend services that power our products.

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
- Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
- Optimize application performance and database queries.
- Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
- Investigate and resolve production issues.
- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
- Collaborate with frontend and mobile developers.
- Contribute to application security and scalability.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of backend development experience.
- Strong knowledge of Python, Java, Node.js, or a similar backend language.
- Good understanding of REST APIs, databases, and distributed systems.
- Experience with Git and software-development best practices.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.
- Familiarity with microservices architecture.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
We are hiring a Digital Marketing Executive to support online marketing campaigns across search, social media, email, and other digital channels. The ideal candidate will combine creativity with analytical thinking to improve traffic, engagement, and conversions.

Responsibilities:
- Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns.
- Assist with SEO, SEM, social media, and email marketing activities.
- Conduct keyword and competitor research.
- Create campaign briefs and coordinate with content and design teams.
- Monitor campaign performance and prepare reports.
- Analyze website traffic and conversion metrics.
- Support paid advertising campaigns across digital platforms.
- Identify new opportunities to improve online visibility.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
- 0–3 years of digital marketing experience; freshers with relevant internships may apply.
- Basic understanding of SEO, Google Ads, social media, and email marketing.
- Strong communication and analytical skills.
- Comfortable working with spreadsheets and marketing dashboards.
- Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Google Ads or Google Analytics certification.
- Experience with Meta Ads, SEMrush, HubSpot, or similar tools.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to improve the reliability, scalability, and deployment processes of our software infrastructure. You will work closely with development and operations teams to automate infrastructure and build efficient CI/CD pipelines.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
- Automate application deployment and infrastructure processes.
- Manage cloud infrastructure and production environments.
- Monitor application and infrastructure performance.
- Troubleshoot deployment and infrastructure issues.
- Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions.
- Improve system reliability, security, and scalability.
- Collaborate with developers to improve deployment workflows.
- Maintain infrastructure documentation.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure experience.
- Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Strong knowledge of Linux and networking fundamentals.
- Experience with Docker and CI/CD tools.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code tools.
- Good scripting skills using Python, Bash, or similar languages.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
- Knowledge of observability platforms and cloud security.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
We are looking for a Customer Success Associate to help customers successfully adopt and use our products. You will build strong customer relationships, resolve concerns, identify opportunities for improvement, and collaborate with internal teams to deliver a positive customer experience.

Responsibilities:
- Support customers throughout their product journey.
- Conduct onboarding and product-training sessions.
- Respond to customer questions through email, calls, and support channels.
- Track customer health, adoption, and engagement metrics.
- Identify customer concerns and coordinate resolutions.
- Collect customer feedback and communicate insights to product teams.
- Maintain accurate customer information in the CRM.
- Identify opportunities for account expansion and retention.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
- 0–3 years of customer-success or customer-facing experience.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong problem-solving and organizational abilities.
- Comfortable working with CRM and customer-support tools.
- Customer-first attitude and ability to manage multiple accounts.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Previous experience in SaaS, technology, or B2B services.
- Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to develop analytical and machine-learning solutions for complex business problems. You will work with large datasets, build predictive models, conduct experiments, and communicate insights to technical and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
- Analyze large and complex datasets to identify meaningful patterns.
- Develop and validate statistical and machine-learning models.
- Perform feature engineering and exploratory data analysis.
- Design experiments and evaluate model performance.
- Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
- Collaborate with data engineers and software developers.
- Build reusable analytical workflows and documentation.
- Monitor model performance after deployment.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of relevant data-science experience.
- Strong Python and SQL skills.
- Experience with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or equivalent tools.
- Good understanding of statistics and machine-learning concepts.
- Strong analytical and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with NLP, recommendation systems, forecasting, or deep learning.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps workflows.

title: Content Writer
description:
We are looking for a Content Writer to create clear, engaging, and search-friendly content for our website, marketing campaigns, product pages, and social channels. The ideal candidate should be comfortable researching unfamiliar topics and adapting their writing to different audiences.

Responsibilities:
- Write blogs, website content, landing pages, articles, and marketing copy.
- Research topics and produce accurate, original content.
- Optimize content for search engines without compromising readability.
- Collaborate with SEO, design, and marketing teams.
- Edit and proofread content before publication.
- Repurpose existing content for different platforms.
- Maintain consistent brand voice and editorial standards.
- Track content performance and improve content based on insights.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
- 0–3 years of professional writing experience.
- Excellent English grammar and writing skills.
- Strong research and storytelling abilities.
- Basic understanding of SEO and keyword optimization.
- Ability to meet deadlines and handle multiple assignments.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Published writing samples or portfolio.
- Experience with WordPress, Google Analytics, or SEO tools.
- Internship or freelance writing experience is welcome.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure for business-critical applications. The role involves cloud operations, automation, security, monitoring, and collaboration with software-development teams.

Responsibilities:
- Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure.
- Configure compute, storage, networking, and database services.
- Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational tasks.
- Monitor cloud environments and resolve infrastructure issues.
- Implement security and access-control best practices.
- Optimize cloud performance and infrastructure costs.
- Support disaster-recovery and backup strategies.
- Collaborate with DevOps and development teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
- 2–5 years of cloud or infrastructure experience.
- Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Understanding of networking, Linux, IAM, and cloud security.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code.
- Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Strong troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or equivalent certification.
- Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, monitoring, and cloud-cost optimization.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
We are looking for a Business Development Executive to identify new business opportunities, generate leads, build client relationships, and contribute to revenue growth. The role is suitable for motivated candidates who enjoy communication, networking, and working toward measurable targets.

Responsibilities:
- Identify and research potential customers and business opportunities.
- Generate leads through calls, emails, networking, and online channels.
- Understand prospect requirements and present relevant solutions.
- Schedule and conduct sales meetings and product demonstrations.
- Maintain lead and opportunity information in the CRM.
- Follow up with prospects and move qualified opportunities through the sales funnel.
- Prepare sales reports and track performance against targets.
- Collaborate with marketing and customer-success teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
- 0–3 years of business-development or sales experience.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
- Comfortable with outbound calling and sales targets.
- Strong interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
- Good organizational and follow-up skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Previous internship or experience in B2B sales.
- Familiarity with CRM systems and sales prospecting tools.
- Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to create intuitive and visually appealing digital experiences. You will work with product managers, developers, researchers, and other designers to understand user problems and turn them into effective product experiences.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct user research and analyze user needs.
- Create user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
- Design responsive interfaces for web and mobile products.
- Collaborate with engineers to ensure accurate implementation.
- Conduct usability testing and incorporate feedback.
- Maintain and contribute to design systems.
- Present design concepts and explain design decisions.
- Iterate on designs based on user and business feedback.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, Visual Communication, or a related field preferred.
- 1–4 years of UI/UX design experience.
- Strong proficiency in Figma or similar design tools.
- Understanding of user-centered design principles.
- Strong visual and interaction-design skills.
- Portfolio demonstrating relevant product-design work.
- Good communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience designing SaaS, fintech, e-commerce, or mobile applications.
- Knowledge of usability testing and design systems.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Cybersecurity Analyst to help protect our systems, applications, and data from security threats. The role involves monitoring security events, investigating incidents, managing vulnerabilities, and supporting security operations.

Responsibilities:
- Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious activity.
- Analyze logs and security events from infrastructure and applications.
- Assist with incident detection, investigation, and response.
- Perform vulnerability assessments and track remediation.
- Support security audits and compliance activities.
- Maintain security documentation and incident records.
- Collaborate with IT and engineering teams on security improvements.
- Stay informed about emerging cybersecurity threats.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
- 1–4 years of cybersecurity or IT-security experience.
- Understanding of networking, operating systems, and security fundamentals.
- Familiarity with SIEM, vulnerability-scanning, and endpoint-security concepts.
- Strong analytical and investigative skills.
- Ability to document and communicate security findings clearly.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Security+, CEH, or equivalent certification.
- Experience with Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, or similar tools.
- Knowledge of cloud security and incident-response processes.

title: Operations Executive
description:
We are seeking an Operations Executive to support daily business operations and ensure processes are completed accurately and efficiently. The role involves coordination across teams, reporting, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate day-to-day operational activities.

- 0–3 years of operations experience.
- Good Excel and reporting skills.
- Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in e-commerce, logistics, banking, or technology operations.

title: iOS Developer

We are looking for an iOS Developer to build and maintain high-quality mobile applications for Apple platforms. You will collaborate with product, design, backend, and QA teams to deliver reliable and intuitive mobile experiences.

- Build reusable UI components and application features.
- Integrate REST APIs and third-party services.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Recruitment Coordinator

We are looking for a Recruitment Coordinator to support the talent-acquisition team with interview scheduling, candidate communication, recruitment documentation, and hiring operations. This is a strong entry-level opportunity for candidates interested in building a career in HR and recruitment.

- Strong communication and organizational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.

- Basic knowledge of MS Excel and HR systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Familiarity with applicant-tracking systems.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to develop software for embedded products and connected devices. The role involves low-level programming, hardware-software integration, debugging, testing, and collaboration with hardware and systems engineers.

Responsibilities:
- Develop embedded software using C and C++.
- Work with microcontrollers and embedded platforms.
- Integrate and test software with hardware components.
- Debug firmware using development and diagnostic tools.
- Develop device drivers and communication interfaces.
- Participate in system-level testing and validation.
- Document software designs and technical changes.
- Collaborate with hardware, QA, and systems teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
- 1–4 years of embedded software experience.
- Strong C/C++ programming skills.
- Understanding of microcontrollers, RTOS, and embedded systems.
- Knowledge of communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, or CAN.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with ARM-based microcontrollers.
- Familiarity with FreeRTOS, embedded Linux, or automotive systems.
- Experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or JTAG debuggers.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Financial Analyst to support financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and business analysis. You will work with finance and business teams to analyze financial performance and provide insights that support decision-making.

Responsibilities:

title: Product Manager
description:
We are looking for a Product Manager to own product initiatives from discovery through delivery and measurement. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, and business teams to identify customer problems and deliver products that create measurable value.

Responsibilities:
- Define product vision, goals, and roadmap.

- Translate customer problems into clear product requirements.
- Prioritize features based on business impact and customer value.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Civil Engineer to support construction and infrastructure projects from planning through execution. The candidate will coordinate with contractors, review drawings, monitor site activities, and ensure work meets quality and safety standards.

Responsibilities:
- Monitor construction activities and project progress.
- Review engineering drawings and technical specifications.
- Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and site teams.
- Inspect materials and workmanship for quality compliance.
- Prepare site reports and project documentation.
- Track quantities, measurements, and project requirements.
- Assist with project scheduling and execution planning.
- Identify site issues and coordinate corrective actions.
- Ensure compliance with safety and engineering standards.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
- 0–3 years of relevant experience; fresh graduates may apply.
- Understanding of construction methods and engineering drawings.
- Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Excel.
- Strong communication and coordination skills.
- Willingness to work at project sites when required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship or academic project experience in construction or infrastructure.
- Knowledge of quantity estimation, BOQ, or project-management software.

title: Technical Content Intern
description:
We are looking for a Technical Content Intern to help create developer-focused documentation, tutorials, product guides, and technical articles. This role is ideal for engineering students or recent graduates who enjoy both technology and writing.

Responsibilities:
- Research technical topics and create clear documentation.
- Write tutorials, how-to guides, product documentation, and technical articles.
- Work with engineers to validate technical accuracy.
- Improve existing documentation based on user feedback.
- Organize technical content for easy navigation and discovery.
- Assist with documentation releases and updates.
- Learn and follow documentation and editorial standards.

Requirements:
- Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
- 0–1 year of experience.
- Strong written English and communication skills.
- Basic understanding of software-development concepts.
- Ability to explain technical concepts in simple language.
- Strong research and learning ability.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with Markdown, Git, APIs, or developer documentation.
- Personal technical blog, GitHub projects, or writing samples are a plus.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to develop and maintain automated testing frameworks for web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers and QA teams to improve test coverage and release quality.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain automated test scripts.
- Create test scenarios for functional, regression, and integration testing.
- Automate API and UI testing workflows.
- Analyze test failures and identify root causes.
- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
- Collaborate with developers to improve testability.
- Maintain test reports and documentation.
- Participate in release validation and quality-improvement initiatives.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
- 1–4 years of automation-testing experience.
- Programming experience in Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.
- Experience with Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent tools.
- Understanding of API testing and REST services.
- Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts.
- Strong analytical and debugging skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
- Knowledge of SQL, Docker, and cloud testing environments.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to analyze inventory, procurement, logistics, and operational data to improve supply-chain performance. The candidate will work with procurement, warehouse, logistics, and business teams to identify inefficiencies and support data-driven decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Analyze inventory levels, demand, procurement, and logistics data.
- Prepare regular supply-chain performance reports.
- Monitor inventory availability and identify potential shortages or excess stock.
- Support demand-planning and forecasting activities.
- Analyze supplier and logistics performance.
- Identify process inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
- Maintain accurate operational datasets and dashboards.
- Collaborate with procurement and operations teams.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Economics, or a related field.
- 0–3 years of relevant experience.
- Strong Excel and analytical skills.
- Understanding of inventory and supply-chain concepts.
- Good problem-solving and communication skills.
- Ability to work with large datasets and operational reports.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, SAP, or other enterprise systems.
- Internship experience in logistics, procurement, or supply-chain operations.
- Fresh graduates with strong analytical skills are welcome.

title: Research Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Research Analyst to collect, analyze, and interpret information for business and strategic decision-making. The role requires strong research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to turn large amounts of information into concise and actionable insights.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct primary and secondary research across relevant markets.
- Collect and analyze industry, competitor, and customer information.
- Build research reports and presentations.
- Validate information using reliable sources.
- Identify trends and summarize key findings.
- Support senior analysts with strategic research projects.
- Maintain research databases and documentation.
- Present findings clearly to internal stakeholders.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business, Finance, Statistics, Research, or a related field.
- 0–3 years of research or analytical experience.
- Strong research, analytical, and writing skills.
- Good knowledge of Excel and presentation tools.
- Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative information.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:
- MBA or Master's degree is an advantage.
- Experience with market research, consulting, investment research, or business intelligence.
- Fresh graduates with strong academic research projects are welcome.
